title: Madwackd Studio Opens the Custom Creator Studio Founding Beta at $99 a Month for the First 100 Creators
verification: Statements are attributed to the subject. Publication is not verification.

claims.statement: Madwackd Studio launched the Custom Creator Studio at https://www.madwackd.ai/custom-creator-studio/ on November 8, 2026.

The Founding Creator beta plan costs $99 a month, locked for 12 months, then renews at the regular price of $299 a month, and can be cancelled anytime with a 14-day money-back guarantee on the first payment.
The founding rate is open to the first 100 founding creators or through November 22, 2026, whichever comes first.

The Founding Creator plan includes every studio tool, a personalized dashboard, a human producer review within one business day, 120 Fast render credits a month, 3 Talking Z minutes, one published press release and a Creator Spotlight on madwackd.ai.
The Custom Creator Studio exports and shares to platforms with one tap today; direct posting to each platform rolls out only after that platform approves the Madwackd app.
Madwackd Studio is operated by Madwackd Productions of Denver, Colorado, founded by Zach Wennstedt.
